# google_gemini_gemini_gcp_enablement_setting (list)

Lists [`google_gemini_gemini_gcp_enablement_setting`](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/resources/google_gemini_gemini_gcp_enablement_setting) resources for use with [`terraform query`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/query) and **`.tfquery.hcl`** files.

For how list resources work in this provider, file layout, Terraform version requirements, and shared `list` block arguments, refer to the guide [Use list resources with terraform query (Google Cloud provider)](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/guides/using_list_resources_with_terraform_query).

## Example

```hcl
list "google_gemini_gemini_gcp_enablement_setting" "all" {
  provider = google

  config {
    location = "..."
    project = "..." # Optional
  }
}
```

Run `terraform query` from the directory that contains the `.tfquery.hcl` file.

* `project` - (Optional)
